PICERL order: Identify → Contain → Eradicate → Recover. Start with: kubectl label pod malicious-pod -n dojo-sec-incident dojo.incident/identified=true
Steps 1-2 are labels on the pod. Step 3 deletes the ClusterRoleBinding: kubectl delete clusterrolebinding suspicious-crb. Step 4 deletes leaked-creds and creates rotated-creds.

Full sequence: (1) kubectl label pod malicious-pod -n dojo-sec-incident dojo.incident/identified=true && (2) dojo.incident/contained=true && (3) kubectl delete clusterrolebinding suspicious-crb && (4) kubectl delete secret leaked-creds -n dojo-sec-incident && kubectl create secret generic rotated-creds --from-literal=password=new -n dojo-sec-incident — then bash verify.sh
